title: Engine follow-ups
author: Shockwave, Engine Lead
body: Projectiles now sweep their whole per-tick path, so fast shots can't tunnel through tanks or thin walls. Tank moves are applied simultaneously, removing the tank-id-order bias. Seeds in replays and CLI output are decimal strings so JavaScript reads them exactly; plain numbers still load. Replay format is now v2.
next: Phase 2 tank rules on top of this core.
